articles.title: Here’s how an Ethereum upgrade helped drain part of Binance’s $6 billion loss
articles.snippet: On Ethereum, the attacker used a 2025 upgrade built to make ordinary wallets smarter, armed with 50 signatures from Binance's own wallet.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin falls below $77,000 as Binance exploit combines with tech woes
articles.snippet: The $6.3 billion Binance hack added to crypto jitters, while weak earnings outlooks and mounting concerns over AI spending pushed the Nasdaq down more than 2%.

articles.title: Binance hack bites India's largest crypto exchange as it curbs futures trading
articles.snippet: CoinDCX has restricted new futures positions after Binance’s security incident disrupted a key liquidity provider. Deposits, withdrawals and customer funds remain unaffected, the exchange said.

articles.title: Binance says 90% of stolen assets replenished, targets Sunday withdrawals
articles.snippet: Less-liquid tokens make up the remaining shortfall as Binance continues buying replacement assets through market and over-the-counter trades.

articles.title: Bitcoin held up better than expected after Binance hack, Strive CEO says
articles.snippet: Strive CEO Matt Cole says the Binance hack has not changed his long-term case for Bitcoin, but cautions it is too early to call a market bottom.
